run_gmr_main: run the GMR data processor to convert kinematic data from a pkl file to SPIDER dataset format
build_gmr_dataset: build a SPIDER dataset from GMR pkl data with configurable robot type, task, and contact detection mode
process_gmr_kinematics: process GMR trajectory data to compute qpos, qvel, ctrl, and contact information using MuJoCo simulation
generate_gmr_visualization: generate kinematic and IK rollout visualization videos from GMR motion capture data for a specified robot
compute_gmr_tracking_error: compute IK trajectory rollout tracking error including position, quaternion, and joint errors for GMR data
